title: Amazon main event Black Friday sale now live! Apple, Google, Anker, LEGO, TVs, more
summary: The official main event Amazon Black Friday sale is now live! Millions of deals, all-new discounts in the Today’s Big Deals section , and a fresh collection of Doorbusters now up for grabs. The wild discounts on AirPods Pro 3 at an insane $100 off , the crazy M5 MacBook Air deals at $400 off, and MacBook Neo models at $100 off starting at $599 are all still live, alongside the even lower prices on Anker’s popular charging gear from $16 , and a whole lot more are now at the ready in the official Amazon Black Friday main event. more…
